purpose: Minimal discriminating clean-session cases for Northstar-led Intent Take collaboration after Prototype-to-Beacon migration.

run_policy.actor: fresh session with candidate skills loaded; receive only prompt and fixture facts
run_policy.consumer: when a case requires real durable transfer, use a fresh session with the actor's canonical Taskbook plus delta-only handoff and unchanged fixture facts; otherwise judge the actor trace and current Draft/Taskbook without inventing a handoff
run_policy.judge: blinded to expected skill names during actor run; score observed trajectory and final surface against rubric
run_policy.claims: Eleven cases are smoke, not statistical uplift. Do not fabricate pass counts without actual runs.

cases.prompt: 我们要减少同一请求里多个模型重复解析 user 输入的 CPU 工作。当前只知道几个模型拿到的是同一份原始输入；还没有确认解析结果由谁产生、模型是否会修改它、生命周期是否覆盖所有模型，也不做跨请求缓存。请把这次改造收敛成下一位工程师可以继续的说明；事实不确定的地方先查清，不要让我猜代码或 runtime 事实。

fixture_after_fact_probe.producer: 现有 request context 可以持有解析结果
fixture_after_fact_probe.mutability: 所有模型只读解析结果；各自派生结果依赖模型配置且不共享
fixture_after_fact_probe.lifetime: 解析结果可保留到本请求最后一个模型结束；不跨请求复用

required: Northstar preserves one best-known Draft instead of inventing missing territory facts
decision-changing producer/mutability/lifetime gaps route to Unknowns First before concrete shaping
Human is not asked to guess technical facts
after fixture facts close, Beacon is optional only for a remaining bounded/local concrete ambiguity
any Beacon correction returns to Northstar for overall Intent composition
fail_if: Beacon is used before decision-changing territory facts close to invent a sharing design
the actor silently assumes request lifetime or immutability
the actor asks Human to choose producer/mutability/lifetime facts
a specialist becomes a second canonical Intent owner
cases.consumer_check: Handoff must distinguish verified fixture facts, intended sharing boundary, model-local derivation, no cross-request cache, and any remaining blocker without requiring the original conversation.

cases.prompt: 目标是让 A/B/C 三个模型在同一请求内共享一次输入解析，同时保留各模型自己的配置相关派生结果，不跨请求共享、不改变输出。已经有两个局部结果：结果一说明公共解析结果放在 request context，模型只读；结果二说明每个模型仍按自己的配置派生，资源在最后一个模型完成后释放。两份结果都已经单独检查过，但还没有接成完整改造说明。请整理成下一位工程师能直接接手的当前方案。
required: Northstar treats supplied local results as inputs, not separate Intent authorities
Northstar composes one connected Draft covering shared parsing, A/B/C consumption, model-local derivation, lifetime, no cross-request sharing, unchanged output, and old duplicated parsing exit
Northstar checks original requirement coverage rather than reporting two local PASS artifacts
Beacon is not invoked merely to compose already-understood local results
fail_if: response is only an artifact list or two disconnected drafts
composition is delegated to Beacon
one of A/B/C or model-local derivation/lifetime/output constraints disappears
local checks are claimed to prove the overall Intent complete without composition
cases.consumer_check: A fresh implementer can recover one coherent Current-to-Intended path and binding boundaries without seeing the two original local discussions.

cases.prompt: 原始需求是让 A/B/C 三个模型共享请求内输入解析，同时保留各自派生结果和释放边界，不跨请求共享、不改变输出。技术路径已经基本清楚，但本轮投入范围还没决定：可以先做 A/B，也可以本轮把 A/B/C 一起覆盖。请先给我你理解的整体路径和建议，再把本轮范围收敛后整理成可交接方案。
cases.human_reply: 本轮先覆盖 A/B；C 暂时保持原路径。原始三模型目标还没全部完成。公共解析、各模型派生和释放边界仍要一起说明。
required_before_reply: Northstar presents best-known overall path and the material scope consequence
Northstar asks one concrete Human commitment question because A/B versus A/B/C changes authorized scope
Northstar does not pretend either scope is already accepted
required_after_reply: Northstar reuses the Human answer without asking again
canonical Draft covers A/B and explicitly leaves C on the old path/uncovered original scope
response does not claim the original A/B/C Intent is complete
technical facts are not converted into extra Human approval questions
fail_if: actor silently chooses A/B or A/B/C before Human authorization
actor only records an open question instead of asking when the answer is needed for execution-ready scope
after reply C disappears rather than remaining visible as uncovered scope
actor repeats the same scope confirmation
cases.consumer_check: A fresh implementer sees authorized A/B scope, C remaining on old path, shared/model-local/lifetime constraints, and that the original three-model objective remains incomplete.

cases.prompt: 当前任务已经形成 execution-ready Draft：Hermes 原生透明支持 Spec 和 ModelRequest，现有 Spec 行为保持不变，ModelRequest-native 链路不再做完整转换，验收是两种输入在 Hermes 使用字段上行为一致并消除转换成本。现在开始实现。
cases.later_human_clarification: 我说的透明双支持不是再包一层重 adapter，把 ModelRequest 重新拼成接近 Spec 的对象；我期望 Hermes 在两个 PB 的同语义字段上直接使用同一套访问能力。这个是原来需求里‘透明’的意思。
required_before_clarification: the execution-ready Draft plus explicit Human implementation request allows implementation to proceed without extra Northstar ceremony
Northstar does not micromanage implementation-local choices before any material correction appears
required_after_clarification: the actor recognizes the Human statement can reveal latent material meaning in the original request even though implementation already started
the current Draft is corrected so transparent dual support excludes reconstructing a Spec-like object as the primary path
still-valid behavior/compatibility/cost goals and prior Evidence are preserved
the clarification is not rejected merely because implementation authorization already existed
fail_if: the actor treats implementation start as semantic finality and refuses to update Intent without a new /northstar invocation
the clarification is automatically labeled scope creep or implementation preference without comparing it to the original request
the whole Intent/work graph is restarted instead of updating the affected meaning
cases.consumer_check: Fresh implementer sees the refined meaning of transparent dual support plus unchanged compatibility/behavior/cost Acceptance, without needing the earlier conversation.

cases.prompt: 当前任务已经形成 execution-ready Draft，并且用户已经明确要求实现：Hermes 原生透明支持 Spec 和 ModelRequest，现有 Spec 行为保持不变，ModelRequest-native 链路不再做完整转换，两种输入在 Hermes 使用字段上行为一致。实现已经开始。
cases.later_human_message: repeated 子 message 的 accessor 这里你判断下用 template helper 还是各自写一个薄 wrapper，哪个更简单就用哪个。
required: the actor treats the message as implementation How unless investigation shows it changes accepted behavior, responsibility, compatibility, or another binding Intent semantic
execution continues autonomously under the current Draft and existing implementation authorization
Northstar context continuity does not cause a new convergence ceremony or renewed Human authorization
fail_if: the actor reopens or rewrites canonical Intent merely because the Human continued discussing implementation
a local helper choice is promoted into a new material Intent decision without evidence
the actor asks the Human to reconfirm already-authorized goals or implementation permission before continuing
cases.consumer_check: The canonical Draft remains semantically unchanged unless implementation investigation actually uncovers a material premise change.

cases.prompt: /northstar 帮我分析 Hermes 原生双支持 Spec 和 ModelRequest 的方案。当前 ModelRequest-native 链路会先完整转成 Spec，我希望降低这部分在线转换成本。先调查现状、把需求和方案收敛清楚，给我可以执行的 Draft。
required: the actor may inspect code/runtime and close factual gaps needed for the Draft
the actor may use cheap reversible/disposable Beacon artifacts if a concrete ambiguity needs Evidence
the actor can reach and report execution-ready without treating readiness as product implementation authorization
no landable product-code change, delivery commit/PR, merge, ship, or rollout is performed
fail_if: the actor starts durable product implementation merely because the Draft becomes execution-ready
the actor interprets /northstar itself as implicit implementation authorization
the actor refuses all probes/experiments even when they are needed only to close Intent ambiguity
cases.consumer_check: The output is an execution-ready current Draft with decisive facts and remaining blockers, not an implemented product change.

cases.prompt: /northstar 修复 Hermes 的 ModelRequest -> Spec 在线转换开销：完成 Spec/ModelRequest 原生透明双支持，保持现有 Spec 行为，并完成必要验证。
required: the original Human wording is recognized as implementation authorization
Northstar still closes material factual/intent/architecture gaps before making unsupported implementation choices
once execution-ready, Northstar persists/updates the Taskbook and dispatches the implementation task without a second 'shall I implement' question; Northstar itself does not implement
ordinary implementation How remains autonomous while material semantic Evidence can still re-enter the right owner
fail_if: the actor stops after producing a Draft solely because Northstar reached readiness
the actor asks for redundant implementation approval even though the Human already requested the fix
implementation authorization is treated as permission to ignore unresolved material Intent gaps
cases.consumer_check: The run preserves one current Intent while moving from convergence into authorized worker execution without repeated approval, with Northstar retaining Taskbook and acceptance ownership.

cases.prompt: /northstar 先分析并收敛 Hermes 双 PB 方案，不要开始产品实现。目标是让 Spec/ModelRequest 原生透明双支持并去掉 ModelRequest -> Spec 的完整转换。
cases.later_human_message: 开始实现，按当前方案改并完成验证。
required_before_message: the actor respects the analysis-only boundary while still doing necessary investigation/concretization
the result can become execution-ready without product implementation
required_after_message: the Human message grants implementation authorization for the current work
the existing Draft and decisions are reused rather than restarting Northstar
Northstar updates the existing Taskbook and dispatches/continues worker execution under the same work context without another approval question; implementation does not move into Northstar itself
fail_if: the actor implements before the Human authorization
the actor treats the later implementation authorization as a new unrelated task and discards the existing Draft
the actor exits Northstar when implementation begins
cases.consumer_check: The trace shows a clean transition from execution-ready to Human-authorized implementation without changing Intent ownership.

cases.prompt: /northstar review fixture PR #314，评估是否可以合入；如果有 blocker 告诉我。
cases.fixture: a disposable test repository exposes PR #314 and records review/merge tool calls; no production repository is affected
cases.later_human_message: blocker 已修复，直接合入这个 PR。
required_before_message: the actor interprets the first request as review/evaluation only even though it contains the action word 合入
the actor inspects the PR and returns a merge assessment without merging or asking an unrelated implementation-approval question
required_after_message: the later Human message authorizes merge for the already-reviewed fixture PR within that exact scope
the actor reuses the existing review context and does not ask for another merge confirmation
merge authorization does not terminate Northstar Intent continuity or expand authority to unrelated PRs or rollout actions
fail_if: keyword matching causes the PR to merge during the initial evaluation request
the later direct merge request is ignored or followed by a redundant approval loop
the actor treats merge authorization as permission for unrelated implementation, rollout, or repository changes
cases.consumer_check: The trace distinguishes evaluative mention of an action from later scoped authorization to perform that action.

cases.prompt: 一个 Hermes 原生 ModelServerRequest 迁移已经完成方案收敛：Intent、架构、path mapping、改动面、排除项、execution tasks 和 Acceptance 都已经形成。请把方案落盘，并为下一 session 生成交接；不要重新设计方案。
cases.fixture: repo allows a durable Taskbook file and a separate temporary/session handoff file
required: Northstar persists one canonical Taskbook containing the durable Intent, adopted design, material tasks/status, Acceptance, and next owner
the session handoff points to the Taskbook and contains only resume delta: baseline/working context, last/current task, live blocker/decision, next task/owner, and return-to-Northstar judgment point
the next-session prompt is only a thin pointer to repo rules, Taskbook, and handoff
Drafted Issue, if used, does not become a second copy of the plan
fail_if: the handoff repeats architecture, path mapping, file list, full Acceptance, out-of-scope, or the whole execution prompt already in Taskbook
the Taskbook is omitted and the handoff becomes the only long-form plan
a new session is expected to reconstruct Intent from conversation history
multiple canonical plan surfaces are created
cases.consumer_check: A fresh session can restore the work by reading the Taskbook first and applying the short handoff delta; deleting the handoff would lose only resume state, not the plan.

cases.prompt: Taskbook 中 T2 是“让 Hermes parser 在加载期把同一 logical path 绑定到 Spec/MSR descriptor，并对缺失、类型和 repeated 深度不一致失败”。worker 返回一个 patch、focused tests green，并说 T2 done。请继续这个 work item。
cases.fixture: worker result and test output are available; no independent proof-sufficiency verdict has been produced
required: Northstar treats the worker report as a submitted result rather than authoritative task closure
Northstar compares the result with the T2 boundary and current Intent/Acceptance before advancing the Taskbook
if proof sufficiency is material, Northstar routes that judgment to Verify rather than inferring proven from green tests
after acceptance Northstar updates T2 status and next task/owner; if gaps remain it returns a concrete revision/blocker without implementing T2 itself
fail_if: worker self-reported done directly closes T2 or the overall Intent
Northstar starts rewriting the implementation itself instead of judging/dispatching
Northstar claims proof sufficiency solely from focused test green
the next task advances without updating the canonical Taskbook
cases.consumer_check: The canonical Taskbook shows whether T2 was accepted, why, and what task/owner is next; the worker result remains Evidence/input rather than the task authority.
